name: Tashuzokukan Mondai Kaiketsu Iinkai 3
original_name: 多種族間問題解決委員会(3)
source:
Due to a specific event that occurred on a global scale, a variety of species from different worlds are living on earth.
There are problems between various species, and to remedy this the [Multi-Species Relations Problem Solving Committee] was created.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE267151.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一场波及全球的事件过后，来自不同世界的各类种族开始在地球上生活。
种族之间难免产生各种问题，为了解决这些问题，“多种族间问题解决委员会”应运而生。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE267151.html]DLsite English[/url]]
